data.body: **[P2] Preserve the existing programmatic call signature.** Making this keyword mandatory causes every existing `validate_description(...)` caller to raise `TypeError`, even when the requirement has no `ExpectedLogs`; `CloudWatchLogRetriever` similarly changed its previously valid two-client constructor. The CLI default does not protect programmatic users. Give both timeout parameters a 120-second default, preferably through a shared constant, so the configuration remains an additive override.
